before: Night Monarch

This edition follows the revised master. The confirmed corrections in Integrated Revision govern brand identity and subsystem ownership, overriding earlier inspiration summaries. Current Edition Notes record subsequent author instructions and recovered source material.
Class Overview
Starting Age: Intuitive
Hit Die: d8
Skill Ranks Per Level: 6 + Int modifier

Class Skills: Acrobatics (Dex), Bluff (Cha), Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Perception (Wis), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), Use Magic Device (Cha)
Proficiencies: Simple weapons, light armor, and bucklers. If this is the character's first level in any class, they may select a martial tradition of their choice.
Casting: Mid-Caster. Uses Charisma as casting ability modifier. Gains 2 bonus talents and may select a casting tradition the first time they gain the casting class feature.
Spell Pool: Level + Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Replenishes after 8 hours of rest.
Practitioner/Operative Modifier: Charisma
Night Monarch Class Progression
Core Class Features
Blended Training

The Night Monarch gains a combat or magic talent every time she gains a class level, according to the class table. Night Monarchs use their Charisma modifier as their practitioner modifier and operative modifier.
Master of Night (Su)

The Night Monarch radiates an aura of dark authority. She gains a bonus on Intimidate checks equal to half her class level (minimum 1). Additionally, fiends, undead, and creatures with the evil subtype take a -2 penalty on saving throws against her abilities. At 10th level, this penalty increases to -4.
Dark Lore (Ex)

The Night Monarch's study of souls and fiendish power grants her insight into the creatures she hunts. She may make Knowledge checks untrained, and adds half her class level to all Knowledge (arcana), Knowledge (planes), and Knowledge (religion) checks. Additionally, when she successfully identifies a creature's abilities or weaknesses, she gains a +1 insight bonus on attack rolls against that creature for 24 hours.
Soul Arts (Su)
The Night Monarch learns how to harvest and control souls of others, gaining the Soul sphere as a bonus feat at 1st level. She uses her Hit Dice as her caster level for all Soul sphere talents.
Bloodline Brands (Su)

As a full-round action, the Night Monarch may attempt to absorb the soul essence of a willing or recently defeated creature, creating a Bloodline Brand. She may only attempt absorption within a number of rounds equal to her class level after the creature's defeat. To absorb a creature, the Night Monarch rolls percentile dice. The base absorption chance is 25%, modified as follows: • +5% per class level • -5% per Hit Die the creature possesses • +10% if the creature is willing If the roll succeeds, the Night Monarch gains a Bloodline Brand tied to that creature's essence, granting her access to that brand's talent list. She may store a number of Bloodline Brands equal to her Bloodline Brands column. If she is already at maximum brands, she must choose one to permanently overwrite. Switching her active brand costs a full-round action.
Succubus Companion
The Night Monarch starts the game with a special companion known as a Succubus at 1st level, bound to one of her Bloodline Brand slots. See the Succubus Companion section for full rules.
Magatama (Su)

At 2nd level, the Night Monarch may customize up to three magatama — sacred gems she spends 8 hours attuning through meditation, ritual, and combat practice. Each magatama represents a unique configuration of power she has drilled into her fighting style. The number of magatama she may have customized simultaneously increases to 4 at 8th level and 5 at 14th level. Each magatama may contain a number of sphere talents equal to the Talents per Magatama column on the Night Monarch table. A magatama must contain a base sphere before additional talents from that sphere may be added, unless the Night Monarch already possesses that base sphere through another source such as Blended Training, the Extra Combat Talent feat, or multiclassing. Talents granted by a magatama cannot be used to qualify for feats or meet prerequisites unless otherwise noted. Spheres and talents that grant skill retraining never do so when gained through a magatama. The Night Monarch may only benefit from one magatama at a time — this is her active magatama. She may switch her active magatama as a swift action. She may customize a new magatama or alter an existing one by spending 8 hours, choosing which talents to lose and which to replace them with.
Infernal Grace (Su)
At 2nd level, the Night Monarch adds her Charisma modifier as a bonus on all saving throws.
Uncanny Dodge (Ex)
At 4th level, the Night Monarch retains her Dexterity bonus to AC even when caught flat-footed or struck by an invisible attacker.
Improved Uncanny Dodge (Ex)
At 12th level, the Night Monarch can no longer be flanked, except by a rogue of at least 4 levels higher.
Archfiend Form (Su)

At 20th level, the Night Monarch permanently becomes an outsider. Her creature type changes to outsider (native) with the evil and extraplanar subtypes. She chooses one fiend subtype — devil (lawful), demon (chaotic), or daemon (neutral) — which cannot be changed. She gains the following permanent benefits: • Darkvision 60 ft (or existing darkvision increases by 30 ft) • Damage Reduction 10/good • Energy Resistance 10 to fire and one energy type appropriate to her subtype (cold for devil, electricity for demon, acid for daemon) • Immunity to poison and disease • No longer needs to eat, sleep, or breathe (may still rest to recover spell points) • Tongues (constant, self only) — communicate with any creature that has a language • Spell Resistance equal to 11 + Night Monarch level • Charisma increases by +4
Infernal Arts

As the Night Monarch's power grows she learns special techniques known as Infernal Arts to further her dark mastery. At 1st level and every 2 levels after that, the Night Monarch learns one Infernal Art from the following list. Unless otherwise noted, each Infernal Art may only be taken once.
Resonance (Su)

The Night Monarch may spend 1 spell point as a swift action to empower her active Succubus companion's supernatural abilities, granting a +2 bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls made with those abilities for 1 round.
Cross Training (Ex)

Through rigorous study or field practice, the Night Monarch has acquired the fundamental ability of another class. She may select one class other than her own to cross-train with. She gains one 1st-level class feature of her choice from the chosen class. She does not gain the chosen class's BAB, saving throw improvements, or spellcasting progression. This class cannot be changed once selected.
Advanced Training (Ex)

Having honed her cross-training further, the Night Monarch now gains class features from the cross-trained class as if she were a number of levels equal to her total character level, but only up to a maximum of 5th level in that class. Prerequisite: Cross Training.
Friends on the Other Side (Su)
The Night Monarch learns to contact a special outsider merchant, allowing her to buy and sell anywhere by spending a full-round action.
Champion Feat (Ex)
The Night Monarch gains any one combat feat as a bonus feat, ignoring prerequisites.
Kindled Essence (Su)
The Night Monarch's studies allow her to kindle her akashic spark, granting her an essence pool equal to her class level plus her Charisma modifier.
Akashic Understanding (Su)

The Night Monarch's studies of akashic energies allow her to bind veils into her chakras, unlocking them in the following order: hands, head, feet, headband, shoulder, wrist, belt, neck. The Night Monarch's veil list contains all veils from the Promethean and Vizier lists, along with the following unique veils: Oni Sword Master's Pauldron, Reaper's Glaive, Night Monarch Warblade.
Energy Nexus (Su)

The Night Monarch learns to convert multiple energy types — spell pool, ki, and essence — between each other. As a full-round action, she can convert up to her Charisma modifier in points of one energy type she controls to another energy type she controls.
Negotiation, My Dear (Ex)
The Night Monarch knows the importance of hazard pay, compensation, and negotiations. She adds her class level to any Diplomacy checks made to earn monetary rewards.
Monster Collector (Su)

The Night Monarch becomes adept at absorbing unusual creatures. When using Bloodline Brands, she can now absorb the essence of monstrous creatures (magical beasts, dragons, etc.), provided they possess supernatural abilities. The number of brands she can store increases by 1.
Rajah Heraldry (Ex)

The Night Monarch can create a magical crest that inspires awe in allies and fear in enemies. As a standard action, she projects an aura (30-ft. radius) for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier. Allies gain a +1 morale bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. Enemies suffer a -1 penalty to these rolls. At 10th level, these bonuses and penalties increase to +2/-2.
Merge Brand (Su)

The Night Monarch can merge two Bloodline Brands into one, combining their abilities. The merged brand counts as a single brand but retains both sets of abilities. Switching to or from a merged brand still requires the standard action cost. At 12th level, the Night Monarch may merge up to three brands.
Amped Brands (Su)

The Night Monarch may augment her brands with Mana Sphere amp talents. When using abilities gained from Bloodline Brands, she may expend 1 spell point to apply a single Mana amp talent she knows to the ability.
True Pure Body (Ex)
The Night Monarch perfects her physical form. She gains the full hit points from her Hit Dice, instead of rolling or taking the average. This applies retroactively to all previous levels.
Leadership (Ex)
The Night Monarch gains the Leadership feat, using her Charisma modifier as the primary determining factor for her cohort and followers.
Soul Sight (Su)

The Night Monarch's dark lore sharpens into supernatural perception. She gains blindsense 30 ft against any creature whose Bloodline Brand she possesses. Additionally she may spend 1 spell point to gain true seeing for 1 round per class level once per day.
Infernal Stride (Su)
The Night Monarch's fiendish nature bleeds into her movement. She gains a +10 bonus to her base land speed.
Magatama Mastery (Ex)

The Night Monarch's attunement to her magatama deepens. She may switch her active magatama as a free action instead of a swift action. Additionally once per day she may benefit from two active magatama simultaneously for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier. Prerequisite: Must possess at least 3 customized magatama.
Succubus Companion
The Night Monarch starts the game with a special companion known as a Succubus at 1st level, bound to one of her Bloodline Brand slots.
Succubus Companion Progression
Brand Bounty (Su)

The Succubus companion may be stored within one of her master's Bloodline Brand slots. While stored, the Night Monarch gains access to all of her Succubus companion's currently known talents as if they were her own. The Succubus companion continues to gain experience and talents normally while stored. Retrieving or storing the Succubus companion requires a full- round action.
Spiritual Development (Ex)
The Succubus companion's physical form grows stronger as her bond with her master deepens. She gains a bonus to both Strength and Dexterity equal to the Str/Dex Boost column on her progression table.
Profane Grace (Su)
At 3rd level, the Succubus companion adds her Charisma modifier as a bonus on all saving throws.
Alertness (Ex)

While the Succubus companion is within reach, her master gains the Alertness feat, receiving a +2 bonus on Perception and Sense Motive checks. If the master already has Alertness, these bonuses increase to +4.
Magi-Change

The Succubus companion can transform herself into weapon or armor forms for her master. Unless noted, all Magi-Change transformations last a number of rounds equal to the Succubus's Hit Dice or until she reverts as a free action.

As a full-round action, the Night Monarch can attempt to absorb willing or recently defeated creatures' life essence to create a Bloodline Brand, gaining access to their abilities as supernatural powers. See Core Class Features for absorption rules. The complete brand list contains 28 brands.
